addons.name: Prayer Times
addons.description: Daily prayer times, the next prayer with a countdown, and the Hijri date, in a card next to the weather button.

addons.name: Notes, To-do & Focus
addons.description: Sticky notes you can pin to the page, a to-do list, and a focus timer with short and long breaks.

addons.name: Planner
addons.description: A daily, weekly and monthly planner with times and repeating items.

addons.name: Break Reminder
addons.description: Gentle reminders to rest your eyes, stretch and drink water, with presets like 20-20-20.

addons.name: Extra Themes
addons.description: Eighteen ready-made colour presets, light and dark, applied in one click.

addons.name: Exam Master
addons.description: Pick board, level, subject, year, session and paper step by step, then open a search for that exact paper. Cambridge, OxfordAQA, Edexcel, AQA and OCR.

addons.name: GitHub Activity
addons.description: A public GitHub profile's recent activity and repositories. Sends only the username to GitHub.

addons.name: Wallpapers
addons.description: A new background picture from NASA APOD, Wikipedia, the Art Institute of Chicago, Picsum or Unsplash, changed daily or on every tab.
